options.html: The normal vector is unchanged; a vector in the plane goes to 0.
The normal vector goes to 0; a vector in the plane is unchanged.

explain: The normal vector is perpendicular to the plane, so its nearest point in the plane is the origin: Pn=0Pn = 0Pn=0. A vector already in the plane is its own nearest point: Pv=vPv = vPv=v. So PPP has eigenvalues 1 (twice, the plane) and 0 (the normal). M13 makes eigenvalues the main subject.

explain: Essentially none. prompt: Why is the least-squares residual perpendicular to every column of A, and what equations does that give?
answer: The fitted values Ax range over the column space, and the point of a subspace nearest to b is where b - Ax is perpendicular to the subspace (any other point is farther by Pythagoras). Perpendicular to the subspace means zero dot product with each column: A^T (b - Ax) = 0, the normal equations A^T A x = A^T b.
